annotations.text:
Android phone 412dp — what ships today

Same web bundle as iOS; the ≤700px rules in index.css drive this layout, so the iPhone and Pixel artboards differ only in width and insets.

Insets
• Status bar 48dp on a Pixel 10 Pro (camera cutout); ~24–32 on older phones. Header pads by it.
• Gesture bar 24dp at the bottom.
• Android 15+ draws edge-to-edge, so scrolled content passes under the status bar text. Open question: add a dark fade under the status bar (both platforms)?

Header
• Title 60px, Fresh Ideas 20px / .30em, taglines stacked 16px
• Mode cards single column

Controls
• 2-column grid, 18px single-line labels, 44dp controls
• Top padding 36px so ZIP / RADIUS labels clear the corner pins (fixed 9/14)
• Plan My Week full width, 56dp — below the first screen, same as iPhone

Body
• Budget bar stacked, price 48px
• Tabs 14px scroll strip; the active tab scrolls into view
• Meal grid 2 columns, day name inside the card
• Recipe cards: script title full width, Favorite under it (fixed 9/14)
• Shopping list: deal badge wraps whole to a second line (fixed 9/14)
• Deals: store name, dates on the next line (fixed 9/14)

Hardware back: closes a modal → returns to the mode's home tab → backgrounds the app.
